home.heroEyebrow: v0.1.0 · A plugin-based text RPG framework
home.heroBody: Covel is a plugin-based framework for building and running text RPGs. World data, rules, character state, and narrative flow can each live in their own module, or ship together as one playable product.
home.heroFootnote: One kernel for play, debugging, and extension.

pipeline.title: One execution path you can inspect and extend.
pipeline.subtitle: Once player input arrives, the system routes runtimes, assembles context, executes plugins, then writes the result back into state and UI.
pipeline.triggerBody: All input enters through one entry point, which decides which runtimes should handle this turn.
pipeline.contextBody: The system assembles world lore, recent messages, character state, and plugin data into the context for this turn.
pipeline.runtimeBody: Runtimes execute according to plugin declarations. Model-backed steps use a model, tool-backed steps use tools.
pipeline.proposalsBody: Plugins turn their output into typed proposals so narrative, state changes, and UI updates all go through the same kernel layer.
pipeline.commitBody: The commit chain validates, enriches, and stores the result so session state stays consistent.
pipeline.renderBody: Once the write completes, the chat view, side panels, and plugin surfaces all refresh to the latest result.

plugins.title: Split gameplay, rules, and surfaces into modules.
plugins.subtitle: Each plugin declares its trigger, priority, and tool scope. The kernel handles scheduling, and the product layer stays replaceable.
plugins.narratorBlurb: Produces the main narrative output and shapes the text the player reads this turn.
plugins.worldInitBlurb: Prepares world structure and seed data before the main loop begins.
plugins.imageBlurb: Picks out visual beats from the turn and hands them to the image pass.
plugins.memoryBlurb: Maintains long-lived memory and archival context so longer sessions stay readable.
plugins.rulesBlurb: Handles rules, dice, and modifiers where deterministic logic belongs.
plugins.charactersBlurb: Tracks NPCs, relationships, and character fields as structured records.
plugins.footnote: Bundled plugins are ready to use, and custom plugins follow the same contract.
plugins.unfilledSlot: Awaiting a plugin to claim this capability.

demo.title: The landing page shows the real workspace.
demo.subtitle: The center pane runs the session, side panels host plugins, and world plus model configuration stays in the same interface.
demo.videoAria: Recording of a Covel session in progress

cta.playBody: Choose a world, configure a model, and open a session.
cta.authorBody: Start with PLUGIN.md and a manifest, then connect your rules, tools, and panels into the product.
cta.contribBody: The repo is split by package and plugin, with clear entry points for product work and deeper integration.
